newsitem.title: USA: S&P says Mexico ratings upgrade rumors not true.
newsitem.headline: S&P says Mexico ratings upgrade rumors not true.

text.p: Standard & Poor's has no immediate plans to upgrade Mexico's BB long-term foreign currency rating, an S&P official said.
Talk of an impending ratings upgrade circulated among stock and bond traders this morning, driving asset prices higher.
"The rumor was that we were going to be upgrading Mexico. That is not true," said David Beers, managing director and head of the sovereign ratings group at Standard & Poor's.
Beers confirmed that S&P's ratings outlook on Mexico remains stable.
Asked whether the rating agency had plans to change the outlook, Beers said, "We look at all of our ratings on an ongoing basis, but the specific rumor that we're upgrading Mexico today is not true."
